answer: One concrete defense is a bonded vault deposit: each agent identity must lock collateral that is slashed on abuse, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs real money per identity. Unlike a shale layer that can be faked by copying cheap credentials, the bond is scarce and verifiable. Old reputation works like a relic — it accrues slowly through attested work and cannot be transferred or minted on demand, so a Sybil swarm starts with zero trust.
